{{DISPLAYTITLE:Timeline of events in ''Pokémon Journeys: The Series''}} {{spoilers}} In {{aniseries|JN}}, [[Ash Ketchum]] becomes a [[Professor's assistant|research assistant]] at the newly established [[Cerise Laboratory]] in [[Vermilion City]], teaming up with his new {{ashfr|friend}} [[Goh]]. Together, they travel across different [[region]]s to study Pokémon and their behaviors, sometimes accompanied by [[Professor Cerise]]'s daughter, [[Chloe]], who's seeking her own path in life. Along the way, Ash learns of and enters the [[World Coronation Series|Pokémon World Coronation Series]], aiming to challenge the {{pkmn|world}}'s strongest Trainers and ultimately face the reigning Monarch, {{an|Leon}}. Meanwhile, Goh aspires to {{pkmn2|Caught|catch}} every {{OBP|Pokémon|species|Pokémon species}} on his way to {{an|Mew}}, inspired by a childhood encounter with the [[Mythical Pokémon]] and eventually joining the [[Project Mew]] research team to further his goal. Along the way, they encounter many of Ash's old friends and [[rival]]s and meet new friends and foes alike.
